sandbachFocus: Sandbach United secured a crucial 1-0 victory at home against Eccleshall on Saturday, with Josh Fowles' early strike proving decisive despite playing the second half with ten men after Hatton's sin bin. The result keeps third-placed Sandbach in the title race on 19 points from 10 games, extending their unbeaten run to six matches (one draw, five wins).
divisionWide: At the top, leaders AFC Bridgnorth faced a stern test against Brereton Social, who took an early lead through an own goal on 26 minutes and held their defensive shape throughout the first half. Second-placed Stafford Town's match against Cheadle Heath Nomads proved dramatic, with Town reduced to ten men after Tom Efford's 63rd-minute red card, eventually drawing 2-2 with an own goal from Wilding adding to their woes. Bilston Town delivered a commanding 3-0 away victory over Market Drayton Town, with Market Drayton reduced to ten men during the contest. Wolverhampton Casuals came from behind to beat Shawbury United 3-1 away with goals from Cian McIntosh, Ablay Sowe's leveller aside, Ben Podmore and a penalty from Kieran Cook. Allscott Heath won 3-1 at home against struggling Alsager Town with goals from James Allen, Liam Parkinson and Kian Newnes. Barnton earned a 1-0 away victory at Telford Town with a 66th-minute goal. New Mills lost 2-1 away at Dawley Town despite Will Frankish's equaliser and Jack Morris's leveller. Crewe faced Wednesfield Community at home in a fixture where both teams are battling near the foot of the table. Foley Meir were scheduled to host Widnes Town, with the latter still seeking their first league win of the season.
